# Data

<!-- Describe input coverage, exclusions, units, and source versions with inline R. -->

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
source(here::here("R", "0_setup.R"))
dt <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "compiled-data.rds")) |>
  dplyr::rename(lon = longitudestart, lat = latitudestart, year = startyear) |>
  dplyr::mutate(month = as.integer(month))
dt   <- sdmTMB::add_utm_columns(dt, ll_names = c("lon", "lat"), utm_crs = dt_crs)
grid <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "prediction-grid.rds"))
mesh <- sdmTMB::make_mesh(dt, xy_cols = c("X", "Y"), cutoff = cfg$MESH_CUTOFF_KM)
has_multiple_gears <- dplyr::n_distinct(dt$geartype) > 1
```

# Analysis

## Products

This report builds the indices the assessment needs. Define the response for each product; `get_index_split()` computes many indices from one fit efficiently.

- **Total biomass** — `spatiotemporal = "ar1"`, no year effect.
- **Over-`r cfg$OVER_CM` cm biomass** — biomass of individuals above the threshold.
- **Length-group abundance** — one index per group in `config.yaml` `LENGTH_GROUPS`.
- **Selected assessment index** — `r cfg$SELECTED_INDEX` (feeds `r cfg$ASSESSMENT_MODEL`);
  often `iid` + `year` as a fixed effect. Confirm with the assessment lead.

```{r fit-products, eval=params$refit_models}
# Fit the total-biomass model (and length-based variants as needed). Example (total):
# `data = dt` sizes the smooth bases to what the survey sampled; use the specification Step 3
# selected rather than the config default whenever the two differ.
form <- build_formula(cfg, has_multiple_gears, data = dt)
dt$value <- dt$rho_biomass
# Years the survey skipped: an `ar1` field assumes evenly spaced steps, and a gap makes sdmTMB
# warn about irregular time spacing and can leave the fit grinding for a very long time.
extra_time <- setdiff(seq(min(dt$year), max(dt$year)), unique(dt$year))
fit_total <- sdmTMB::sdmTMB(
  form, data = dplyr::filter(dt, !is.na(value)), mesh = mesh,
  family = model_family, spatial = "on", spatiotemporal = "ar1", time = "year",
  extra_time = if (length(extra_time)) extra_time else NULL,
  control = sdmTMB::sdmTMBcontrol(newton_loops = 2)
)
saveRDS(fit_total, file.path(out_dir, "model-fit-total.rds"))
# … fit over-X-cm and per-length-group models similarly (adapt the response per product).
```

```{r load-products, eval=!params$refit_models}
fit_total <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "model-fit-total.rds"))
```

## Indices

```{r}
#| label: fig-report-indices
#| fig-cap: "Estimated annual total-biomass index. Shading spans the returned lower and upper limits."
pred_total  <- predict(fit_total, newdata = grid, return_tmb_object = TRUE)
index_total <- sdmTMB::get_index(pred_total, bias_correct = params$bias_correct,
                                 area = grid_cell_area_nmi2)
saveRDS(index_total, file.path(out_dir, "index-total.rds"))

ggplot2::ggplot(index_total, ggplot2::aes(year, est)) +
  ggplot2::geom_ribbon(ggplot2::aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), alpha = 0.3) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Year", y = "Total biomass index")
```

<!-- Describe the supported finding and refer to @fig-report-indices. Confirm caption units, sample size, and interval definitions against the generated result. -->

## Results

```{r}
#| label: fig-report-results
#| fig-cap: "Final-model diagnostics: fixed effects, annual prediction maps, spatiotemporal random fields, and residual quantiles."
plot_fixed_effects(fit_total)
plot_prediction_map(pred_total, crs = dt_crs, column = "est", type = "annual")
plot_random_field(pred_total, crs = dt_crs, field = "epsilon")
plot_residual_qq(fit_total)
```

## Export the assessment index

```{r export}
# Resolve the configured product explicitly. Never silently substitute the total index.
source(here::here("R", "assessment_index_handoff.R"))
index_products <- list(
  "Total biomass" = index_total
  # Add every other configured product here, using its exact config name.
)
# Versioned handoff: observations plus enough context for the assessment to interpret them.
assessment_index <- build_assessment_index_handoff(
  index_products, cfg$SELECTED_INDEX,
  list(
    units = cfg$ASSESSMENT_INDEX_UNITS,
    uncertainty = "se is standard error on log(est); lwr/upr are returned limits",
    index_type = cfg$ASSESSMENT_INDEX_TYPE,
    timing = cfg$ASSESSMENT_INDEX_TIMING,
    spatial_scope = cfg$REGION,
    provenance = list(
      project = "index-wise",
      source = "{{SPECIES_SLUG}} step 4 assessment report",
      git_commit = tryCatch(
        system2("git", c("-C", shQuote(here::here()), "rev-parse", "HEAD"),
                stdout = TRUE, stderr = FALSE),
        error = function(e) NA_character_
      )
    )
  )
)
saveRDS(assessment_index,
        file.path(out_dir, "assessment-index.rds"))
```
